item.title: Kansas Profile: Sarah Bell, Kansas Museum of History
item.description: What is Kansas? Why Kansas? Those are fundamental questions that demand thought and reflection, and would benefit from a place to learn and share the history of our state. Such a place exists at the Kansas Museum of History, which recently reopened after a multi-million dollar renovation.

item.title: What's in a Name?
item.description: I don’t get too in the weeds on professional football. They’ve got plenty of talking heads to cover all the points, from every conceivable angle, all day long.

item.title: Why is Trump skipping the Super Bowl? Oft-traveling president says it's 'too far.'
item.description: The Los Angeles Rams won't be the only no-shows at the Super Bowl. President Donald Trump will be conspicuous in his absence from the biggest annual, single-day sporting event in the United States.

item.title: K-State Dishes Out First Home Loss to Arizona State
item.description: TEMPE, Ariz. — Kansas State shared the ball, shot the lights out and built a cushion large enough to withstand a late push.

item.title: Kansas Rallies to Force Overtime Before Falling to Colorado, 69-66
item.description: LAWRENCE, Kan. – The Kansas Jayhawks hit four free throws in the final 39 seconds of regulation to force overtime, but Colorado outscored the Jayhawks 15-12 in the extra session to claim a 69-66 victory Sunday afternoon at Allen Fieldhouse.

item.title: McPherson Competes in Washburn Open and Coach Wilson Invite
item.description: McPherson College competed in two separate meets this past weekend, with some competitors heading back to Washburn University to compete in the Washburn Open and others (primarily throwers) made their way down to Wichita State to participate in the Coach Wilson Invitational. Women's HighlightsIn the jump's category, Stephanie Schmidt would compete in both the Long Jump and the High Jump.

item.title: Lakers star LeBron James named an NBA All-Star for a record 22nd time
item.description: NEW YORK — Lakers star LeBron James made the NBA All-Star team for a record 22nd time Sunday after being selected as a Western Conference reserve by NBA coaches.

item.title: Renewable Fuels Association Pushes for Year-Round E15 Sales Amid Legislative Setback
item.description: The Renewable Fuels Association (RFA) is pushing to make E15, a gasoline blend containing 15% ethanol, available year-round, a move the industry says would benefit both consumers and retailers. Derrick Piney, chairman of the RFA, described the effort as a long-awaited milestone.

item.title: Rooted in strength
item.description: Last week I attended Kansas Farm Bureau’s Day at the Statehouse along with a couple hundred of my fellow Kansas Farm Bureau members. If you have never attended a Day at the Statehouse, I highly recommend doing so — it is truly an example of grassroots advocacy in action and proof of why Farm Bureau is so effective advocating for farmers and ranchers.
